title: Fix search saying No items yet. when nothing matches
body:
A search with no matches now says no item matches it, instead of claiming the list is empty.

**Preview:** none — local review only

## What you should know

- **Behaviour change:** a search that matches nothing shows "No items match “<search>”." (escaped). An empty table still says "No items yet.".
- **Decisions:** bug fix: the failing test is the spec (`test/search.test.js`, "no matches").
- **Changed after the go:** nothing
- **Tests deleted or loosened:** none
- **Manual steps for you:** none

## Evidence

- **Screenshots:** no browser in this session
- **Reviewer:** pending
- **CI:** not run yet
- **Low findings:** none

<details>
<summary>Engineering details</summary>

`src/index.js` counts the items when a search finds none and picks the message; the page template takes the message. The new tests failed before the fix.

</details>
